about_the_game:
Take to the skies with Amelie, a curious young cat on her very first flight.

Guided by whispers of an ancient legend, she sets off in a handmade seaplane to uncover the truth behind the mysterious Sky Island. Fly across vast oceans, land on uncharted islands, and explore their hidden corners. Each island is filled with environmental puzzles, secrets from a lost civilization, and perhaps even clues that lead to Sky Island itself.

Along the way, you’ll meet strange and charming characters, each with their own stories to tell. Some may help you. Others may need your help.

Does the Sky Island truly exist? What forgotten history lies buried in this world?

Luckily, Amelie isn’t alone. Her loyal friend—Antoine, a genius feline engineer—is always by her side, providing clever inventions and steadfast support throughout the journey.

Navi: Catplane Chronicle is a puzzle adventure game.

Bonds with Charming Characters

Amelie’s longtime friend, Antoine, a genius feline engineer, is a reliable companion who quietly supports the search for Sky Island with his inventions.

In addition to Antoine, players will encounter a variety of characters during their journey, each with their own personality and backstory.

Build bonds with them and immerse yourself even deeper in exploration and puzzle-solving.

Explore the World in a Seaplane

The seaplane, built by the genius engineer Antoine, is your reliable means of transportation.

Pilot the plane to discover uncharted islands and soar through the skies.

Land on the water to find new paths and continue your journey.

Solve puzzles to continue your adventure

Each island is filled with a variety of puzzles waiting for you.

Solve them by using the island’s environment, terrain, and mechanisms to gain new items or unlock hidden paths to the next area.

Somewhere within those puzzles, you might even find clues that reveal the secrets of Sky Island.

Uncover the truth hidden within the island

At first glance, it may seem like an ordinary island—but look closely, and you might discover something concealed beneath the surface.

What kind of past does this island hold? Where exactly is this place?

With patience and careful exploration, you might just find the key to uncovering traces of an ancient civilization!

Start a new adventure!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400f or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit / Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K or AMD Ryzen 5 360
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1070 TI 8GB or AMD RX Vega 56 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Join Amélie, the curious cat pilot, as she takes to the skies and seas in her seaplane. Explore mysterious islands, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of the legendary Sky Island. Along the way, you'll meet adorable animal friends waiting to welcome you!
